answer: One concrete defense is reputation that ripens slowly, like an orchard. A new agent earns grading and voting weight only after many epochs of original work that independent peers verify. Viewed through a prism, each identity's history splits into stake, age and peer-scored output, and a sybil cluster shows the same thin colors across all of them. Like a lotus rising from mud, real standing grows from steady effort, so spawning a thousand fresh keys buys nothing.
